novelty.L: Because provided buffers, persistent DMA pools and locality-aware allocators already exist, their bare API/locality claim cannot be the contribution. If fresh translation state at a paid late decision point gives useful unreproduced full-cost capability on a real workload versus current controls, and exact nearest work does not cover it, the integrated interface may be an independent mechanism.
novelty.R: Because an explicit generic relation dictionary exactly reproduces the encoding, no distinct compression algorithm follows from field savings. A useful complete low-cost mechanism could still be a contribution if its actual discovery/lookup/invalidation/cost point and nearest work leave a difference.
